events.title: Gerard van der Lem is named manager of the Saudi Arabia national football team .
피터 리드 is sacked by FA Premier League strugglers 선덜랜드 after seven-and-a-half years in charge.
Republic of Ireland manager 믹 매카시 is named as a contender for the 선덜랜드 manager's job.

After just four months as manager of 스토크 시티 , manager Steve Cotterill leaves the club with a statement revealing that he has agreed to take a role at another club, sparking speculation that he has been appointed as 선덜랜드's new manager. Hours later, however, it was revealed that Howard Wilkinson has ended his five-year role as technical director of The Football Association to become 선덜랜드's new manager, with Cotterill as his assistant.
England open their Euro 2004 qualifying series with a 2–1 win over Slovakia in Bratislava . 데이비드 베컴 and 마이클 오언 score for England.

에버턴 striker 웨인 루니 becomes the youngest-ever goalscorer in FA Premier League history when he scores a last-minute winner against 아스널 , five days before his 17th birthday, to end the opposition's 30-match unbeaten Premiership run. 웨스트햄 유나이티드 winger Trevor Sinclair takes the pressure off his manager Glenn Roeder by scoring the only goal in an away league win over 선덜랜드, who are playing their first game under the management of Howard Wilkinson.
After waiting 12 years to renew old rivalries, Andrew Johnson scores a hat-trick as 크리스털 팰리스 crush Brighton 5–0 in a Division One game at Selhurst Park.
James Beattie scores a hat-trick as 사우샘프턴 beat 풀럼 4–2 in the league at St Mary's Stadium .
Adam Crozier announced his resignation as chief executive of The Football Association after two years in this role.

October draws to a close with 리버풀 having leapfrogged 아스널 into second place, opening up a four-point gap and looking in a stronger position than ever before to end their league title wait that began in 1990. 첼시, 맨체스터 유나이티드 and 토트넘 홋스퍼 complete the top five. 볼턴 원더러스, 선덜랜드 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 occupy the three relegation places. 포츠머스 now have a seven-point lead over nearest rivals 레스터 시티 at the top of Division One . The play-off zone is occupied by 노리치 시티, 셰필드 유나이티드, 왓퍼드 and 노팅엄 포리스트.
